evidence.summary: Registry declarations, observations, events, and generated views must be persisted by the Python host.

reproduction.instructions: Attempt the minimal host_write/file-effect reproducer preserved in the originating pressure record.

summary: Implementing the canonical exchange required durable JSON files, append-only Git-friendly directories, timestamps, and digest-preserving filesystem writes; the current MNCS profile has no expressible file-write effect for this boundary.

workaround.description: Keep transport, filesystem, Git, timestamp, and JSON persistence in the Python host while retaining the pure lifecycle law in MNCS source.
